email_scenario.subject: Action Required: Your Sqrock account will be disabled
email_scenario.body:
From    : IT Security <it-security@sqrock.example>
To      : riya@company.com
Subject : Action Required: Your Sqrock account will be disabled

Hi Riya Sharma,

Our security team noticed a login associated with
Bangalore, India.

Please verify your account within 24 hours to avoid
temporary account suspension.

[VERIFY ACCOUNT]
https://lab.internal/awareness-test

Regards,
IT Security Team

--- AWARENESS TRAINING SCENARIO ---

psychological_triggers.reason: The sender impersonates internal IT Security at Sqrock.
psychological_triggers.defense: Verify suspicious IT alerts via direct out-of-band communication channels.

psychological_triggers.reason: Imposes an artificial 24-hour verification deadline to induce pressure.
psychological_triggers.defense: Pause and evaluate security actions regardless of stated deadlines.

psychological_triggers.reason: Threatens account suspension to compromise recipient judgment.
psychological_triggers.defense: Adhere to standard corporate authentication practices during urgent notices.

psychological_triggers.reason: Leverages recipient metadata including name, employer (Sqrock), and location (Bangalore, India).
psychological_triggers.defense: Recognize that open-source intelligence (OSINT) allows attackers to customize phishing hooks.

red_flags.reason: The message presents itself as an IT/security communication.
An unexpected account-security message should be independently verified.
Account suspension is presented as the consequence of not complying.
The recipient is encouraged to follow a supplied verification path.
Publicly observable personal information is used to increase credibility.

defensive_guidance.detail: Contact IT/security through an official internal channel rather than using contact information provided by the suspicious message.

defensive_guidance.action: Do not trust the display name
defensive_guidance.detail: A familiar-looking sender name does not prove that the message originated from the claimed organization.
Navigate to known official services independently instead of following suspicious verification links.

defensive_guidance.action: Do not allow urgency to bypass procedure
defensive_guidance.detail: Security procedures should remain consistent even when a message claims immediate action is required.
Forward suspicious messages to the organization's security or phishing-reporting process.

email_authentication.SPF: Checks whether the sending infrastructure is authorized to send mail for the claimed domain.
email_authentication.DKIM: Uses a cryptographic signature to provide domain-level message authentication and integrity information.
email_authentication.DMARC: Uses domain policy and alignment checks involving SPF and/or DKIM and provides reporting capabilities.
email_authentication.defensive_note: Email authentication improves protection against domain impersonation but does not eliminate every form of phishing.
